hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Two rows can be made all ones simultaneously if and only if they are identical or exact bitwise opposites.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Normalize each row so its leading element becomes zero by flipping when necessary.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Identify the canonical row pattern with the highest occurrence frequency.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
